purpose_context: Foundation of the Vikunja configuration reset (#714): Felix and Kent need a stable, API-queryable label vocabulary before tasks can be migrated or saved filters built. This mission creates the four-dimension label taxonomy via an idempotent helper and removes three drifted legacy labels, producing the label-id map that #716/#717/#718 depend on.
purpose_tldr: Create the canonical 12-label friction/Eisenhower/type/effort taxonomy in Vikunja and clear the legacy labels.
